If you are interested in learning about the following activities check the appropriate event. The appropriate Guild representative will follow-up with you. For more information visit our website.

  • Art in the Park: In the summer AIP members can exhibit and sell original artwork on Mondays in Harwich Port’s Doane Park. Artists can sign-up for the entire season or on a weekly basis.
  • Bank Shows: Members can be part of a program that exhibits original artwork in local bank lobbies including Cape and Coast Bank in East Harwich.
  • Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists: Members are invited to be juried into the Gallery to show and sell their original paintings in our gallery in downtown Harwich Port.
  • Community Painting Events: The Guild facilitates periodic community painting events where members mentor developing artists of all ages to foster the creation and appreciation of art.

The Guild is always looking for members willing to share their time, skills, and talents on a regular or intermittent basis. Please check your area(s) of interest you can contribute to:
